from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the document as written (e.g., '判决文书 X' or official title)")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The specific type of adjudicative document (e.g., 二审判决书，再审裁定书)")
    case_domain: str | None = Field(description="The legal domain of the case (e.g., 民事，行政，刑事)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
